_comment: Higher tier = hotter colour, matching AmmoTierColors so both mods read the same way. Valid colours: red, orange, violet, blue, green, grey, yellow, black, default.
_headsetComment: Sprint hearing distance in metres, from the wiki's Earpieces table. Bare ears are 53m and the ceiling is 67m, so the whole spread is 14m - the bottom band is worth very little over wearing nothing.
_hearingComment: The item database carries no hearing stat - every headset reads AmbientVolume -50 and DryVolume -60 - so these come from the wiki's measured table and are matched on the name.
_carrierComment: A plate carrier is armorClass 0 - the plates carry the class - so colouring a carrier by its own class paints every good one grey. Colour it by the best class it will accept instead.
_recolourComment: Rigs and helmets are almost all 'default' already, so recolouring them loses nothing. Body armour is mostly blue, which carries no information either. Set false to leave a category alone.
